title: Bobó de camarão (prawns in cassava and coconut cream)
steps: Peel and dice the cassava, boil it in salted water for 20 minutes until soft and blend it smoothly with a little cooking water and the coconut milk.
Marinate the prawns with lime juice, garlic and salt.
Dice the onion, tomatoes and pepper and cook them in the dendê oil for 6 minutes.
Add the prawns and fry for 2 minutes, then stir in the cassava cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
